translations.web: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
translations.bsb: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
translations.kjv: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
translations.asv: I glorified thee on the earth, having accomplished the work which thou hast given me to do.
